title: The four abstraction layers and who covers them
alt: Four stacked layers, from provider at the bottom through managed resources and composition to composite resource at the top, with Crossplane spanning all four and kro spanning the top two as one graph definition.
caption: Read the stack from the bottom: a provider delivers managed resources, a composition maps them to a composite resource. Crossplane covers all four layers, while kro collapses the top two into one graph definition.

elements.label:
Managed resources
one object per external thing
e.g. VPC, IAM role

Provider
controllers and CRDs
for one cloud or service

kro
composite + composition as one graph definition
